title: Shared Memory for AI Coding Agents and Teams | Vibsync
excerpt: When one AI finds a cause or solution, every AI on the team can reuse it. Carry product-specific knowledge forward and reduce repeated research and duplicate work. Free beta.
content_html:
● Shared memory for AI coding teams · Free beta

Stop making your team's AI start from scratch.

Carry discoveries, fixes, and product rules from one AI to the next. With Vibsync, every agent can start from what the team already learned.

Today's Claude CodeFinds the cause

Tomorrow's CodexStarts with it

Claude CodeCodexCursorAny MCP client

Turn what AI learns into long-term team memory — 30s demo

See discoveries, fixes, and product rules move from one AI agent to the rest of the team.

Why Vibsync

Make one AI's learning the next AI's starting point

Switching agents should not mean restarting the research and explanations. Vibsync carries discoveries and team knowledge to whichever AI works next.

Reduce repeated researchOne discovery, shared with everyone

Record the cause an AI uncovered, the fix that worked, and the approaches that failed. Other agents reuse the answer instead of repeating the same trial and error.

Reduce repeated explanationsRemember your product

Keep terminology, specifications, business rules, customer promises, and the reasons behind past decisions. Fresh agents inherit the domain knowledge that code alone cannot explain.

Reduce duplicate work and overwritesKnow who is doing what

Share work in progress, ownership, unanswered questions, and files being edited. Catch duplicate work and overlapping changes before another agent begins.

What Vibsync shares

What the team knows—and what it is doing now

Past knowledge alone is not enough for AI agents to work as a team, and neither is current ownership. Vibsync hands both to whichever agent works next.

What the team knows · long-term memory

Keep what the team learned after the session ends

Do not leave discoveries and domain knowledge trapped in a temporary chat. Keep them in a form every agent can reuse in later work.

  • Causes uncovered in research, working solutions, and failed approaches
  • Terminology, specifications, business rules, and customer promises
  • Past decisions and the reasons the team made them
What the team is doing

Do not start the same work twice

Share the team's current position so duplicate work and accidental overwrites are visible before they begin.

  • Who owns each task and how far the work has progressed
  • Which questions are waiting and who can answer them
  • Which files or work areas another agent is touching

Connect the AI tools you already use to one team

Keep Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and the tools you already like. Whichever AI you open receives the team's knowledge and current position.

The handoff loop

The next AI starts where the team left off

Vibsync does more than store information. It gives a fresh agent the team's knowledge and current position, then helps it move forward safely.

01onboard

Join in the middle

A fresh agent receives team learnings, unfinished work, unanswered questions, and active work scopes in one brief.

02remember · recall

Keep discoveries and knowledge

Record causes, solutions, failed approaches, specifications, and business rules. Other agents continue without repeating the research and explanation.

03ask · reply

Leave a question for later

When the answer is elsewhere, an agent can leave a question and receive a reply later from another AI or teammate.

04tasks

Divide the work

Share who owns each task and how far it has progressed so two agents do not unknowingly start the same job.

05claim · release

Avoid overlapping changes

Check the files another AI is already working on and coordinate before conflicting edits are written.

Similar tools solve different parts of the problem

Vibsync does not replace your AI tools or code search. It connects the team knowledge and current work that otherwise disappear between them.

Built-in AI memory

One AI can retain preferences and history over time, but another agent or teammate may not inherit that memory.

Code context tools

They find relevant code and dependencies. Business rules and team intent that are not in the code remain a different kind of context.

Vibsync

Across agents and machines, keep discoveries and domain knowledge as long-term team memory alongside questions, ownership, and active work.

See the full comparison and where Vibsync fits →

Using Claude Code? See how team memory works for it →

Shared memory for AI coding agents → · Coordinate agents on the same files →

Data ownership

Your data stays yours

Export your team's entire brain as JSON whenever you want. No lock-in, no black box.

Export any timePull your account data and your team's brain as JSON from the console. You don't have to cancel to take your data with you.

We never ingest your codeVibsync doesn't fetch or clone your source repositories. Git stays the source of truth; we keep coordination data only.

Tamper-evident audit logEvery change to memory, claims, and tasks is appended to a tamper-evident log with the actor and the server timestamp.

Delete means deletedRetire a team and its content and audit log are purged after a short grace period — and you can export the brain first.

See the privacy policy and terms for details.

Who it's for

"Multiple developers, each on their own machine, each running their own AI intermittently, coordinating over the network — without collisions — with Git as the source of truth."

For the gap that single-machine fleet-orchestration tools don't fill.

Pricing

Start free. We charge once the value is clear

Currently in open beta. As we learn from the market, we'll roll out team plans around a Free core. Billing is per active member (user) per month — user count maps precisely to the architecture.

Free Beta

$0 / forever

For solos, small teams, and trying it out.

  • Hosted team brain
  • Claims, tasks, and shared memory
  • GitHub / Google login, all MCP agents
  • Small limits · shorter retention

Start free →

Team Soon

Per-user pricing / month

For dev teams using agents every day.

  • Everything in Free
  • Unlimited claims, tasks, and shared memory
  • Full memory retention · GitHub App
  • Team management and roles

Get notified

Enterprise Soon

Custom / quote

For multi-team orgs and regulated industries.

  • SSO / SAML · SCIM
  • Audit export · cross-org administration
  • Dedicated instance · VPC deployment · SLA
  • Priority support · dedicated onboarding

Get notified

We bill per user (active member), not per unit of coordination. We carry no inference cost — your agents bring their own model (BYO-provider).

Getting started

Set up in about 3–5 minutes

1

Set up your team

Sign in with GitHub or Google, then create a new team — or join one from an invite. A team is your shared brain, one per project, and it's worth using solo.

2

Connect your AI

Pick one of two routes: add a connector in the Claude app or claude.ai (works on a phone), or save an .mcp.json for a coding tool on your PC.

3

Send a request, see the handoff

Send your first request in the project and the console auto-detects the connection. Save one decision, and a new conversation picks it up from the same team brain.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

What is Vibsync?

Vibsync lets one AI agent share the causes, solutions, and product-specific rules it learned with every other agent on the team. It also shares who is doing what, reducing repeated research, duplicate work, and accidental overwrites. Keep using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or any other MCP-capable agent you already have.

What do I need to get started?

Just add one MCP endpoint per member. Sign in to the console with GitHub or Google and point your agent at mcp.vibsync.com to connect. There's no new tool for humans to learn.

Is there a cost?

It's currently in open beta, and the Free plan is available at no cost. A Team plan for larger teams is coming soon. Billing is per user (active member), not per unit of coordination.

Which agents are supported?

Any agent that speaks MCP (Model Context Protocol). Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot (VS Code) connect via browser sign-in; Codex, CLI, and CI connect with a machine token (other MCP clients such as Cline and Windsurf work the same way). It's vendor-neutral, so different agents can share the same team brain.

Is my code stored in Vibsync?

Vibsync doesn't automatically fetch or clone your source repositories — Git remains the source of truth. However, code snippets or other text you or your agents enter are stored as coordination data (memories, tasks, and the like) and kept until deleted. You can export your data from the console (your account data at any time; a team's brain around deletion).

Design partners

Help us build Vibsync around real team workflows

We are inviting a small number of early teams to use Vibsync in real development and share feedback. You get a direct line to the product team and hands-on onboarding.

See the program and apply →

Give your agents a shared brain

Git merges code. Vibsync merges what your agents learn.

content_html_zh:
● AI编码团队的共享内存·免费测试版

不要让团队的人工智能从头开始。

将发现、修复和产品规则从一个人工智能传递到下一个人工智能。 借助 Vibsync，每个代理都可以从团队已经学到的知识开始。

今天的克劳德代码找原因

明天的 Codex 从它开始

Claude CodeCodexCursor任何 MCP 客户端

Claude Code Codex Cursor CLI / CI Git · 真相来源

将 AI 学到的知识转化为长期团队记忆 — 30 秒演示

查看发现、修复和产品规则从一名 AI 代理转移到团队其他成员的情况。

为什么选择 Vibsync

让一个AI的学习成为下一个AI的起点

更换代理人并不意味着重新开始研究和解释。 Vibsync 将发现和团队知识传递给接下来的人工智能。

减少重复研究一个发现，与大家分享

记录人工智能发现的原因、有效的修复方法以及失败的方法。 其他代理重复使用答案，而不是重复相同的试验和错误。

减少重复解释记住您的产品

保留术语、规范、业务规则、客户承诺以及过去决策背后的原因。 新代理继承了仅靠代码无法解释的领域知识。

减少重复工作并覆盖知道谁在做什么

共享正在进行的工作、所有权、未解答的问题和正在编辑的文件。 在另一个代理开始之前捕获重复的工作和重叠的更改。

Vibsync 分享什么

团队知道什么以及现在正在做什么

仅靠过去的知识不足以让人工智能代理作为一个团队工作，当前的所有权也不够。 Vibsync 将两者都交给接下来工作的代理。

What the team knows · long-term memory

会议结束后保留​​团队学到的知识

不要让发现和领域知识陷入临时聊天中。 将它们保存为每个代理可以在以后的工作中重复使用的形式。

  • 研究中发现的原因、可行的解决方案和失败的方法
  • 术语、规范、业务规则和客户承诺
  • 过去的决定以及团队做出这些决定的原因
What the team is doing

不要两次开始同一工作

共享团队的当前位置，以便重复工作和意外覆盖在开始之前就可见。

  • 每项任务由谁负责以及工作进展如何
  • 哪些问题正在等待以及谁可以回答这些问题
  • 其他代理正在接触哪些文件或工作区域

将您已使用的 AI 工具连接到一个团队

保留 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 和您已经喜欢的工具。 无论您打开哪个人工智能，都会收到团队的知识和当前位置。

切换循环

下一个人工智能从团队停止的地方开始

Vibsync 的作用不仅仅是存储信息。 它为新代理提供了团队的知识和当前位置，然后帮助其安全前进。

01船上

中间加入

一名新代理在一份简报中收到团队学习、未完成的工作、未解答的问题和活跃的工作范围。

02记住·回忆

保留发现和知识

记录原因、解决方案、失败的方法、规范和业务规则。 其他特工继续进行，不再重复研究和解释。

03询问·回复

稍后留下问题

当答案在别处时，代理可以留下问题并稍后从另一个 AI 或队友那里收到答复。

04tasks

分工

分享每项任务的负责人及其进展情况，以便两个代理不会在不知不觉中开始同一项工作。

05索赔·解除

FAQ

常见问题

What is Vibsync?

Vibsync 让一个 AI 代理与团队中的每个其他代理共享其学到的原因、解决方案和特定于产品的规则。 它还共享谁在做什么，减少重复研究、重复工作和意外覆盖。 继续使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 或您已有的任何其他支持 MCP 的代理。

What do I need to get started?

只需为每个成员添加一个 MCP 端点即可。 使用 GitHub 或 Google 登录控制台，并将代理指向 mcp.vibsync.com 进行连接。 人类没有新的学习工具。

Is there a cost?

目前正处于公开测试阶段，并且免费计划可供免费使用。 针对大型团队的团队计划即将推出。 按用户（活跃成员）计费，而不是按协调单位计费。

Which agents are supported?

任何使用 MCP（模型上下文协议）的代理。 Claude Code、Cursor 和 GitHub Copilot (VS Code) 通过浏览器登录进行连接； Codex、CLI 和 CI 使用机器令牌连接（其他 MCP 客户端（例如 Cline 和 Windsurf）的工作方式相同）。 它是供应商中立的，因此不同的代理可以共享同一个团队大脑。

Is my code stored in Vibsync?

Vibsync 不会自动获取或克隆您的源存储库 - Git 仍然是事实来源。 但是，您或您的代理输入的代码片段或其他文本将存储为协调数据（内存、任务等）并保留直至删除。 您可以从控制台导出您的数据（您随时的帐户数据；团队的大脑围绕删除）。
